summary: Randolph Hodges, as Executive Director of the Florida Department of Natural Resources, is listed among the agencies that endorsed the proposal or offered no adverse comments on the Draft Environmental Impact Statement pertaining to ORV use on public lands. His name also appears in the cc line of the Florida State Planning and Development Clearinghouse's cover letter transmitting agency comments to the Bureau of Outdoor Recreation. No individual statement or specific concerns from Hodges are recorded in the document window.
